Motivation:

Dynamically adjust the number of workers at runtime.

Modification:

- Introduced IoUringIoHandlerOption to initialize IoUring instances with greater flexibility.
- Added a new API in IoUringIoHandler to dynamically adjust the number of workers at runtime.

Result:

Fixes #14648
